scientific.integrity: The Entropy-SGD inner recurrence is solved exactly in expectation on every SPD eigendirection; the exact quadratic Gibbs mean supplies the ideal local-entropy Hessian, and monotonicity of the finite filter proves the condition-number interpolation.
limitations: Expected exact-gradient behavior on SPD quadratics.
Thermal-noise covariance and nonlinear outer dynamics are not characterized.
No optimal inner-loop length is claimed.

title: Finite Entropy-SGD inner loops interpolate between raw and local-entropy conditioning
